remarks: Fabulous "Value Range" Price! NY Styling Luxury Living at "1 BROAD STREET".  Concierge High Rise in the Heart of Downtown. Spectacular Unobstructed Views over the Mill River Park. Luxurious bath with double sinks, Walk-In-Shower and separate spa tub. Perfect 1 BR with half bath for guests. Enjoy First Class Service and many Amenities for convenient luxury lifestyle. 24/7 Concierge! All Season Pool, Fitness Center, Resident Lounge for entertaining with Billiards Table. Shuttle service to Train, Rooftop lounge with amazing views of Long Island Sound. Pet Friendly. Rent Parking $220/Mon. Enjoy events in Downtown Stamford - Restaurants, Mill River Park, Pickle Ball and More!
